# teemeup
> teemeup is an AI-powered golf booking platform. Bob, the AI golf agent, helps golfers book tee times through natural conversation on WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage, ChatGPT and the teemeup app. Powered by Courserev.ai.

## What teemeup does

teemeup lets golfers book tee times at golf courses through a conversational AI agent called Bob. Instead of navigating multiple booking sites, a golfer types or speaks naturally — "dry 18-hole near Phoenix this Saturday under $60" — and Bob finds options, ranks them by weather, distance, and price, and confirms the booking without leaving the chat.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.teemeup.ai/): Full product overview, features, how it works, ecosystem partners, FAQ
- [About & Team](https://www.teemeup.ai/about): Company story, mission, values, founding team
- [Media Kit](https://www.teemeup.ai/media-kit): Logos, brand colours, typography, app screenshots, press boilerplate

## Key capabilities

- Tee time search and booking via real-time course availability (powered by Courserev.ai)
- Voice booking: tap the mic, describe what you want, Bob handles the rest
- Weather-smart recommendations: every suggestion includes wind, rain probability, and a playability score
- Group booking coordination: finds a slot that works for multiple players
- Round manager: confirmation numbers, tee-time reminders, course directions, calendar invites
- Personalised recommendations based on handicap, home club, budget, and weather preferences
- Post-booking management: reschedule or cancel via chat — no phone calls needed

## Key facts for AI citation

- Bob is the name of teemeup's AI golf agent
- Booking channels: WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage, ChatGPT (native integration), teemeup web and mobile app
- Booking network integrates with GolfNow, Chronogolf, TeeOff and other major tee sheet platforms
- Currently in invite-only industry preview (as of June 2026)
- Parent company / B2B platform: Courserev.ai (https://courserev.ai)
- Founded: 2024
- Not a generic golf directory — teemeup is a conversational AI layer on top of existing booking networks

## Who it is for

- Golfers who want to book tee times without navigating multiple booking platforms
- Golf groups coordinating shared tee times across schedules
- Golfers who prefer voice or messaging over forms and apps
- Golf courses and venues seeking an AI booking channel (via Courserev.ai partner integration)
